blocks.text: MANILA , Philippines — Instead of changing the conviction rate threshold, Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano believes the impeachment court should just amend its rules to allow absent senator-judges to participate through electronic means. Cayetano revived this push on Wednesday as House prosecutor Rep. Chel Diokno insisted that senator-judges should be physically present in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte. Diokno believes this will enable the senator-judges to assess the evidence against her and later vote whether to convict or acquit her. However, Cayetano asked Diokno whether the existing rules or the Constitution prevent his four colleagues in the minority to participate electronically. He was apparently referring […]...
